findings.location: source.html paragraph: "I ordered a copy of The Martyr’s Mirror and was astounded...","translation.html paragraph: corresponding paragraph
findings.source_quote: I ordered a copy of The Martyr’s Mirror and was astounded when I read about these people who lived like the disciples.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate or present the cited work title in Russian (or provide a parenthetical Russian rendering). For example: «Я заказал экземпляр «Зеркало мучеников» (The Martyr’s Mirror) и был поражён…» — preserve the tag and its placement.
findings.translation_quote: Я заказал экземпляр The Martyr’s Mirror и был поражён, читая о людях, которые жили, как ученики.

findings.location: source.html paragraph quoting Matthew 10:22: "And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake...","translation.html same paragraph
findings.source_quote: “And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved” (Matt. 10:22).
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the mistranslation of the quoted Scripture. The translation currently reads «…за имя Мёе…» which is a mistranscription and changes the wording of the verse. Replace with a faithful Russian rendering of the printed English quotation, preserving citation and quotation marks. For example: «„И будете ненавидимы всеми за имя Мое: но терпящий до конца спасётся“ (Матф. 10:22).» — ensure chapter/verse format and quotation placement match the source.
findings.translation_quote: «И будете ненавидимы всеми за имя Мёе: но терпящий до конца спасётся» (Матф. 10:22).

findings.location: source.html paragraph: "He was telling me that, yes, while Jesus says we are the light of the world, lights are supposed to shine quietly. They don’t speak.","translation.html corresponding paragraph
findings.source_quote: He was telling me that, yes, while Jesus says we are the light of the world, lights are supposed to shine quietly. They don’t speak.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify grammatical agreement to reflect plural reference ("lights") in Russian or make explicit reference to the implied plural. For example: change «Он не говорит.» to «Они не говорят.» or rephrase: «Они не говорят, они должны тихо светить.»
findings.translation_quote: Он хотел сказать, что да, хотя Иисус говорит, что мы — свет мира, свет должен тихо сиять. Он не говорит.
